data.body: Follow-up from hive-flow-bba8. The live agy 1.0.16 canary proved --sandbox does not provide absolute-path write confinement in restricted modes: warm bare --sandbox wrote to abs-tmp and repo root; --sandbox plus skip-permissions wrote to sibling, parent, abs-tmp, HOME, repo-root, symlink, and hardlink for both write and shell tools. Do not rely on agy --sandbox as a write boundary. Implement a fail-closed provider behavior for gemini restricted/no-write and artifact-confined work: either deny native file-write dispatch or exclude gemini from modes requiring write confinement until a real OS confinement primitive exists.
data.title: Fix gemini restricted-mode write safety after bba8 agy sandbox canary
